title: Avro and merged schemas
prompt: This program saves the 5 lesson invoices as Avro, then as two Parquet folders with different columns, and reads them back. What does it print? Type each line on its own line.
program:
invoices.select("invoice_id", "invoice_date", "total_amount").write.mode("overwrite").format("avro").save("/tmp/c2/avro")
print(spark.read.format("avro").load("/tmp/c2/avro").dtypes)

invoices.select("invoice_id").write.mode("overwrite").parquet("/tmp/c2/a")
invoices.select("invoice_id", "status").write.mode("overwrite").parquet("/tmp/c2/b")
merged = spark.read.option("mergeSchema", "true").parquet("/tmp/c2/a", "/tmp/c2/b")
print(merged.columns, merged.count())
hints: Avro stores its schema with the data, so types survive the round trip.
Reading two folders gives the rows of both.
`mergeSchema` combines the columns of every file; it doesn't remove rows.
